summary: Computes an incremental moving average of input a2 using the sample count at this+0x28 as the weighting denominator and storing the result at this+0x48. The base term is the old average at this+0x48 when count is 1, the raw input when count is 0, and (count-1)*old_average otherwise. When the count is zero the input is stored directly, then the averaged value is stored and clamped: a compare-flag branch writes 1065353216 (1.0f) and an over-range branch writes 1102053376 (22.0f). Called by SeasonScoringInfoUpdater.

operations.description: Select the weighted base term: old average at this+0x48 when count at this+0x28 equals 1, the raw input as float when count is 0, or (count-1)*old_average at this+0x48 otherwise.
Sum the selected base term and the input a2 converted to double.
If the count at this+0x28 is zero or negative, store the raw input directly at this+0x48.
Zero-count path: store the input as a float at this+0x48.
Divide the accumulated sum by the count at this+0x28 to produce the averaged value.
Store the averaged value at this+0x48.
If the floating-point compare flags (v8|v9) indicate the unordered/below-range case, write 1065353216 (1.0f) to this+0x48.
Else if the averaged value exceeds 22.0, write 1102053376 (22.0f) to this+0x48.
Clamp path: store the lower clamp 1065353216 (1.0f) or the upper clamp 1102053376 (22.0f) at this+0x48.
